style: A centered painterly medieval CK3 trait icon. Dark, richly colored digital oil illustration with soft dramatic lighting and visible brushwork. Use a compact backing shape matching vanilla trait icons, with genuinely transparent pixels outside the backing silhouette. Keep the subject readable at 120x120. No text, letters, full-canvas background, or elaborate frame.

icons.kehillah_rabbi_trait: A bearded scholar in a dark kaftan and kippah, in profile, hunched over a large open book on a lectern with a single candle beside it. Face in shadow, pages turned away, no legible writing. Square softly worn teal-blue backing with transparent outside corners, like vanilla Religious Scholar.
icons.kohen: A pair of hands raised in the traditional priestly blessing gesture, fingers parted, wrapped in a white prayer shawl with blue stripes. Round muted green and gold medallion backing with transparent outside corners, like vanilla Sayyid.
icons.levite: One simple, clearly recognizable ancient biblical lyre or harp, carved warm wood with a few visible strings. Round muted green and gold medallion backing with transparent outside corners, like vanilla Sayyid.
icons.kehillah_apostate_trait: A broken red wax seal with a clear six-pointed Star of David impressed into it. Round distressed red-brown seal backing and transparent outside corners, like vanilla Excommunicated.
